claims.quote: An earlier inquiry from our construction services team requested discovery about disconnected teams. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.draft:
Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for your engagement with Cedar Systems. We understand that your construction services team previously requested discovery about disconnected teams, but we’ve learned that the project is currently paused and there may be some disagreement about the requirement.

To ensure we align properly and provide the best support, could you please clarify the current status and requirements of the project? This will help us prepare effectively for any next steps.

We look forward to your response and are happy to assist further.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Your Contact Information]
questions: What is the current status of the project?
Are there any specific requirements or concerns that need to be addressed before resuming?
uncertainties: There is a contradiction in the project status between the initial inquiry and the latest call.
